title: Microbial Reductive Dechlorination of Hexachlorobutadiene by Dehalococcoides
authors: Wang, X., Wang, H., Qian, X. et al.
abstract: Hexachlorobutadiene (HCBD), a persistent organic pollutant (POP), poses a significant threat to ecological environments and human health. While anaerobic microbial transformation is a promising remediation strategy, the specific microorganisms and metabolic mechanisms involved have remained poorly understood. This study demonstrates the successful enrichment of an anaerobic microbial consortium from river sediment, with lactate as an electron donor, capable of transforming HCBD. Within 240 days,
